newsitem.title: FRANCE: Pechiney falls on Cheuvreux downgrade.
newsitem.headline: Pechiney falls on Cheuvreux downgrade.

text.p: Shares in aluminium group Pechiney fell more steeply than the Paris stockmarket on Friday after brokerage Cheuvreux de Virieu downgraded the share to a sell, portfolio managers said.
"Cheuvreux is quite negative regarding Challenge (Pechiney's recently announced restructuring plan) and doesn't expect the plan to yield improvements in the short term," one manager said.
The share was down 3.34 percent at 237 francs at 1215 GMT, while the bourse's CAC-40 index was 1.3 percent lower.

Pechiney last week announced a 1996 loss of three billion francs. Chairman Jean-Pierre Rodier recalled at a news conference that the restructuring plan's benefits would kick in significantly from 1998 with the full impact expected in 1989. He expressed a cautious outlook for 1997.
